items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: I know Pete. I know Pete before I know Manuel. Pete was playing banjo with Clyde, with no, with the Brown Buddies band. And then he joined Clyde Coors band. And I come in there after Morgan.

ctx.x: And uh, Pete was playing clarinet. I mean uh trumpet.
Yeah, Bocard. Pete. Yeah, I remember that. Uh, Peter Bocard. Yeah, they used to have Louis Gallo down there one time too.
